themes.label: In-network status is wrong
themes.why: Patient books on a shown in-network status and is billed out-of-network. Direct financial harm.

subthemes.label: Listed as in-network, turned out not to be
Billed after booking an in-network provider
Provider does not take the plan at all

themes.label: Booking never reaches the practice
themes.why: Confirmed on Zocdoc, absent from the practice calendar. Patient is turned away at the door.

themes.label: Practice cancels or drops the appointment after booking
themes.why: The appointment is confirmed and then killed by the practice or the platform, so the patient loses the care slot they planned around.

themes.label: Locked out of the account
themes.why: Sign-in, password reset, email change and lockout failures stop booking entirely.

subthemes.label: Cannot log in or create an account

themes.label: Cannot complete the booking flow
themes.why: The patient gets partway through booking and the flow dead-ends on a disabled control or an opaque error, so no appointment is created at all.

themes.label: AI search replaced classic search and filters
themes.why: Rollout regression: patients lose name lookup, map and filter controls with no opt-out.

subthemes.label: AI answers instead of a list of providers
No way to opt out or get classic search back

themes.label: Search returns nothing bookable
themes.why: The patient searches and the product returns zero or unbookable providers, so they abandon care or go to a competitor.

themes.label: Filters return the wrong providers
themes.why: Specialty, distance, visit-type and day filters are not honoured; patient books the wrong care.

subthemes.label: Asks for a filter that does not exist
Filter is ignored or resets itself

themes.label: Problems with an appointment already booked
themes.why: Covers cancel/reschedule, video visits and calendar sync. The sub-theme split is the useful read, not the total.

subthemes.label: Will not add to the phone calendar
Booked appointment is missing from the list

themes.label: Provider listing does not match reality
themes.why: Wrong specialty, hours, address, or a practice that has closed. Wasted visits.

themes.label: Generic error / crash / will not load
themes.why: Opaque failure with no recovery path. Spikes here read as incidents.

themes.label: Cannot search for a provider by name
themes.why: The most common intent (I know who I want) has no working entry point.

themes.label: Notifications & email
themes.why: Marketing volume, missing reminders, and tone-deaf campaign sends.

themes.label: Family / dependent profiles
themes.why: Cannot manage or book for dependents cleanly.

themes.label: Payments & cost estimates
themes.why: Cost display, copay estimates and charges.

themes.label: Well Guide checklist
themes.why: "Mark as done" and checklist state fail to save.

themes.label: Intake forms block or repeat
themes.why: Forms loop, lose answers, or are demanded again at the office.

themes.label: Cannot edit profile or contact details
themes.why: Email, phone, name and profile fields are read-only in the product, so patients cannot correct the details providers use to reach them.

themes.label: Reviews & ratings
themes.why: Review submission and rating display issues.

themes.label: Saved providers list is unusable
themes.why: Favourites unreachable, un-removable, or gated behind a prior booking.

themes.label: Plan missing or unselectable in the picker
themes.why: Patient cannot express their real coverage, so every downstream network answer is wrong.

themes.label: Accessibility & display
themes.why: Dark mode, contrast and text sizing defects.

themes.label: Provider messaging
themes.why: Cannot reach the practice through the product.
